tools.name: perseus_agora
tools.description: List tasks from the project task board (tasks/*.md files). Use to see what is open, in progress, or completed. Filter by status. Read-only; returns task array with id, title, status, scope.

status.description: Filter tasks by status: open, in_progress, completed, cancelled

tools.name: perseus_auto_skill
tools.description: Instruct the agent to load a specific skill before starting work. Use at the top of context documents to enforce critical hygiene skills (e.g., memory-hygiene, agent-safety). Renders as a mandatory instruction block. Read-only.

skill.description: Name of the skill the agent should load before beginning work

tools.name: perseus_budget
tools.description: Declare a token budget for the rendered context (renders as empty text). Enforced by `perseus prompt-size`: an over-budget render warns — or fails with `strict` — with a per-directive byte/token breakdown (#606). Declarations are read from source text before conditionals are evaluated; top-level only — a @budget inside an @include'd file is not enforced (prompt-size warns) (#626). Read-only.

tools.name: perseus_capture
tools.description: Write recent session checkpoints to Perseus Vault as durable memories (#713) — the write side of the memory loop, symmetric to @memory recall. Idempotent per checkpoint (re-render upserts, never duplicates). Use at session boundaries so lessons persist immediately instead of waiting for a scheduled harvest. WRITES to the vault; never cached.

tools.name: perseus_context_diff
tools.description: Render a compact 'Since last session' delta (#714): git branch/commits, Agora task-board changes, new inbox messages, new checkpoints, and new vault session memories since the last recorded snapshot. Use at the top of a context document so the assistant spends zero turns re-orienting on unchanged state. Maintains its own per-workspace snapshot (refresh debounced by render.context_diff_min_age_s); reset=true forces a new baseline. Never cached.

tools.name: perseus_date
tools.description: Current date/time

format.description: Date format using tokens YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss, z (default: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss). strftime-style %Y %m %d %H %M %S tokens are also accepted.

tools.name: perseus_drift
tools.description: Detect drift between predicted and actual tool usage patterns via the Pythia oracle. Use when tool behavior seems off or after config changes. For workspace hygiene checks, prefer perseus_health. Read-only; returns a markdown drift report.

tools.name: perseus_env
tools.description: Embed environment variable

required.description: If 'true', render fails when the variable is unset

fallback.description: Value to use when the environment variable is not set

schema.description: JSON Schema to validate the env var value against

source.description: Where the value was resolved from

tools.name: perseus_focus
tools.description: The global-workspace tier: a small, capacity-bounded (default 32), salience-ranked set of items Perseus broadcasts into context — the shared 'what I'm working on now' set for the agent and its subagents. With no args, renders the current working set. add=/pin= admit items; the lowest-salience non-pinned items are evicted when it overflows. Distinct from long-term recall (@vault/@memory): bounded and actively maintained, not unbounded memory.

add.description: Text of an item to admit into the workspace (bounded, salience-ranked)

pin.description: Text of an item to pin (floated to top, never evicted)

unpin.description: Text of a pinned item to unpin

drop.description: Text of an item to remove from the workspace

touch.description: Text of an existing item to reinforce (bump frequency/recency)

clear.description: If 'true', remove all items from the workspace

weight.description: Base salience weight for a newly added item (default 1.0)

source.description: Optional label for where a newly added item came from

tools.name: perseus_health
tools.description: Audit workspace context health: stale skills, duplicate tasks, oversized output. Use before starting work to catch drift. For deep Daedalus heuristics (cache, directive stats), use perseus_get_health. Read-only; returns status enum and metric counts.

status.description: Overall health: ok, warning, or critical

stale_skills.description: Count of skills past freshness threshold

oversized_context.description: Whether rendered context exceeds size limits

tools.name: perseus_inbox
tools.description: Read agent-to-agent messages from the workspace inbox. Use to check for coordination messages from other agents. Filter to unread only. Read-only; returns message array with read/unread status.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return

read.description: Whether the message has been read

tools.name: perseus_include
tools.description: Include and render another Perseus source file, recursively resolving its directives. Use to compose context from multiple files or share common sections across workspaces. Bound a growing file with last=N (final N lines) or since=14d/2w/24h (recent dated sections only). Use mode=reference (or render.host_loaded_paths) to emit a one-line pointer instead of inlining files the host agent already loads natively. Read-only; resolved directives inherit the parent configuration.

path.description: File path to include and render (relative to workspace root)

last.description: Keep only the final N lines of the file (bounds a growing log)

since.description: Keep only dated sections within a window, e.g. 14d, 2w, 24h

tools.name: perseus_list
tools.description: List directory contents or structured data. Use to discover files before reading with perseus_read. Supports sorting by name, modified time, or size. Read-only; for hierarchical view, prefer perseus_tree.

path.description: Directory path to list (default: workspace root)

tools.name: perseus_mason
tools.description: Query the Mason code architecture concept map to find which files implement a feature. Use before editing code to understand where changes should go. Read-only; returns concept map and mapped file list.

query.description: Feature or filename to look up in the Mason code architecture map

tools.name: perseus_memory
tools.description: Search LOCAL project memory (FTS5, zero-network) for past decisions and architecture notes. Use for in-workspace recall. For cross-session persistent facts, use perseus_vault instead. Read-only; returns results array with mode and count.

mode.description: Query mode: search, narrative, or federation

query.description: Search query string for BM25 / hybrid recall

scope.description: Memory scope filter: working, core, or all

render.description: If 'true', render matched memories as markdown

focus.description: Time focus: recent, today, week, or all

workspace.description: Target workspace path for scoped queries

tools.name: perseus_perseus
tools.description: Fetch rendered context from a remote Perseus instance by URL. Use to pull live workspace state from another machine or container. Read-only; caches results — re-fetch when remote state may have changed.

url.description: URL of the remote Perseus instance to fetch context from

source_url.description: URL of the remote Perseus instance

tools.name: perseus_profile
tools.description: Select the per-model context profile for this document (#608): sets the context target and memory posture (on_demand/relevant/always) used by the automatic memory injection layer. Use at the top of a context document, e.g. @profile claude-sonnet-4-6. Unknown names fall back to the default profile. First-wins (#627): with multiple @profile lines only the first non-fenced one governs — later banners are marked ignored, and @profile inside a code fence is documentation, never a directive. Read-only.

model.description: Model name (or context-window class) whose profile to resolve, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6; unknown names fall back to default

tools.name: perseus_prompt
tools.description: Define a system prompt block that instructs the AI assistant about how to use the rendered context. Use to set behavioral rules, memory hygiene gates, or context interpretation guidelines. Read-only; rendered as-is into the output.

tools.name: perseus_read
tools.description: Read and embed file contents into the rendered context. Use to inject config values, environment files, or any text file. Can extract specific keys from structured files. Read-only; use perseus_list or perseus_tree to browse before reading.

path.description: File path to read (relative to workspace root)

key.description: If reading a config file, extract this key only

fallback.description: Value to use when the file or key is not found

schema.description: JSON Schema to validate file contents against

tools.name: perseus_research
tools.description: Search an EXTERNAL paper-search MCP server (BGPT by default) for scientific literature and inject per-paper Methods/Results blocks. Use to ground claims in published studies. Self-gates on research.enabled; degrades gracefully when the provider is unreachable. Read-only; speaks JSON-RPC over stdio (no shell).

tools.name: perseus_services
tools.description: Health-check all services listed in the workspace context (HTTP endpoints, Docker containers, shell commands). Use to verify the environment is healthy before starting work. May make network calls and execute shell commands per service definition — side effects depend on configured checks.

tools.name: perseus_session
tools.description: List recent session digests with task summaries and outcomes. Use to understand what was done recently across sessions. For the single most recent checkpoint, prefer perseus_waypoint. Read-only; returns session array with count.

count.description: Number of recent sessions to include (default: 3)

tools.name: perseus_skills
tools.description: List available skills with descriptions and freshness status. Use to discover what capabilities are installed. Filter by category for smaller output. Read-only; stale skills flagged automatically.

flag_stale.description: If 'true', mark skills not updated within threshold as stale

category.description: Filter skills by category (e.g., devops, github)

limit.description: Maximum number of skills to list

tools.name: perseus_tokens
tools.description: Embed token budget for rendered context

tools.name: perseus_tool
tools.description: Run an external tool that has been allowlisted in the Perseus configuration. Use for approved integrations only. Requires the tool name to be present in the allowlist. Destructive — executes the tool with the user's permissions.

name.description: Name of the allowlisted external tool to run

tools.name: perseus_tooltrim
tools.description: Return filtered toolset metadata and usage statistics. Use to understand what tools are available and how they are being used. For full tool metadata, set full=true. Read-only; stats mode returns aggregated counts.

tools.name: perseus_tree
tools.description: Display a directory tree with configurable depth. Use to understand project structure at a glance. For flat file listings with metadata, use perseus_list instead. Read-only; depth limits control output size.

path.description: Directory path for tree display (default: workspace root)

tools.name: perseus_validate
tools.description: Validate a rendered block against a JSON Schema. Use to enforce structure on configuration blocks, task definitions, or any schema-constrained section. Read-only; returns pass/fail with error messages.

schema.description: JSON Schema to validate the rendered block against

tools.name: perseus_vault
tools.description: Query Perseus Vault for scoped, durable context. Read-only; falls back to the local Vault FTS5 index when the service is unavailable.

query.description: BM25 FTS5 search query for persistent memory recall

tools.name: perseus_waypoint
tools.description: Return the most recent session checkpoint: what was being worked on, status, and next steps. Use at session start to resume where you left off. Stale after TTL (default 24h). Read-only; lightweight — call freely.

ttl.description: Max age in seconds for a valid checkpoint (default: 86400)

tools.name: perseus_get_context
tools.description: Return the full rendered Perseus context for the workspace.

format.description: Output format: markdown or json (default: markdown)

workspace.description: Workspace path the context was rendered for (json format only)

tools.name: perseus_get_health
tools.description: Run Daedalus context-maintenance heuristics — cache health, directive resolution stats, memory integrity check. mode=basic (default) returns the @health maintenance report; mode=doctor returns the same structured payload as `perseus doctor --json` (per-check status + summary), the MCP equivalent of the CLI doctor surface for restart/health verification.

mode.description: Health mode: basic (default, maintenance heuristics report) or doctor (full doctor --json equivalent structured diagnostics)

status.description: Overall health status: ok, warning, or critical

mode.description: Health mode used: basic or doctor

summary.description: Doctor check tally: {ok, warn, error} (doctor mode)

checks.description: Individual doctor check results, identical to `perseus doctor --json` (doctor mode)
